title: Build the Google Ads Performance Coach Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/google-ads-performance-coach.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach/kit.
Kit contents: Google Ads Performance Setup Checklist; Measurement Review Prompt; Period Review Prompt; Qualified Outcome Worksheet; Calculation Workbook Template; Action Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Exports; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'Google Ads Performance Coach', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a current-period table with exactly 2 data rows whose campaign names are Spring Promo and Brand, a previous-period table with the same 2 campaign names, a conversion-actions table containing page_view and form_submit, and a GA4 table containing /spring-landing and /contact. It also shows 'form_submit (completed contact form)', '2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30', and '2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31'.

Step 2 shows the exact heading 'MEASUREMENT REVIEW FIRST'. Spring Promo is listed as failed with text containing 'page_view', '96', and '12'. Brand is listed as passed with text containing 'form_submit'. Spring Promo is listed as skipped for efficiency.

Step 3 shows workbook text '=1860/96', '19.38', and meaningful 'no' on Spring Promo, and '=290/22', '13.18', and meaningful 'yes' on Brand. It shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. The AI INTERPRETATION line contains 'not meaningful until tracking changes'. The RECOMMENDED ACTION line contains 'Do not change bids yet'.

Step 4 shows the Spring Promo CONFIRMED line with primary_conversion = page_view. Activating 'Check facts against the export row' reveals three rows (primary_conversion, conversions, cost), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values page_view, 96, and 1860.

Step 5 shows Brand previous-period text '=275/19', '14.47', '=290-275', '15', '=22-19', and '3'. It shows 'Search-terms export: not provided' and the sentence 'Re-run after 14 days with a new campaign export. Do not change bids yet.'

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You change it in Google Ads. The kit changes nothing.' and 'Do not change bids yet.' and a link to /blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every campaign name, landing path, date, click, cost, conversion, session, and event count in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.

Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', 'per month', or a price. The only dollar figures are the fictional campaign costs and workbook results (1860, 290, 1420, 275, 19.38, 13.18, 14.47).
Neither page contains a percentage, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.
The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach'.
GET /blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach/kit.

Google Ads Performance Coach is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'google-ads-performance-coach', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'google-ads-performance-coach') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'Google Ads Performance Coach Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no Google Ads Performance Coach entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Measurement Review Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'MEASUREMENT REVIEW FIRST', 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'qualified outcome', 'page_view', 'Do not change bids', 'Do not edit the Google Ads account', 'Do not invent'.

The Period Review Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'only after', 'measurement', 'visible formulas', 'previous period', 'Do not change bids', 'Do not invent', 'Do not edit the Google Ads account'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Qualified Outcome Worksheet has a visible label 'Qualified outcome (what must happen before a conversion counts)' whose default value is 'form_submit — completed contact form', two checkboxes with visible labels 'page_view does not count as a qualified outcome' and 'add_to_cart does not count as a qualified outcome' (both checked by default), a visible label 'Campaigns to mark out of scope (one per line)', plus a 'Generate My Measurement Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Qualified outcome: form_submit — completed contact form.', 'page_view does not count as a qualified outcome.', 'add_to_cart does not count as a qualified outcome.', 'Run MEASUREMENT REVIEW FIRST before any efficiency ranking.', 'If the primary conversion is not the qualified outcome, stop. Do not change bids.', and 'Do not edit the Google Ads account.' The block has a Copy button. The block contains no 'Always skip' line.
If the qualified-outcome field is empty or whitespace only, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a qualified outcome.' and generates no rules block.
When 'Campaigns to mark out of scope (one per line)' is empty, the generated rules block contains no 'Always skip' line. When it contains 'Brand', the block contains 'Always skip: Brand'.

The Calculation Workbook Template shows the columns campaign, period, clicks, cost, conversions, primary_conversion, formula, result, meaningful. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'campaign,period,clicks,cost,conversions,primary_conversion,formula,result,meaningful' and whose Spring Promo current row contains '1860', '=1860/96', '19.38', and 'no'.

The Action Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.
The Fictional Sample Exports section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the campaign, previous, conversion-action, and GA4 rows and headers from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the Google Ads Performance Coach card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no Google Ads Performance Coach entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the Google Ads Performance Coach card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Security Readiness Action Pack entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach/, components/premium/google-ads-performance-coach/, and src/lib/premium/google-ads-performance-coach/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/google-ads-performance-coach/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/google-ads-performance-coach/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
